lifetime.enforcement: Sole wait4 owner of fresh pure worker; bounded wall then kill/reap only unreaped direct child, stdout/stderr preserved. Independent fresh-child kernel and owner peaks after exit; retrospective512MiB, no hard OS cap or RSS sampler claim.
lifetime.scope: Workers have no subprocess/engine/training/native execution path; temporary files only, no descendant process claim.

complete_original_trace_byte_corresponde.scope: Every original byte compared against independent full insertion-order C-json grouped fields plus exact nested search/tree/children stream. All fields emitted once, tuple/list arrays JSON equivalent. No complete original inflation, full tree copy or complete output string; chunk size is measured, not a claimed hard cap.

receipt.scope: Every actual node/full universe/census/scheduler/base fallback/hint/rollback/feature/RNG/action and applicable complete learning update. No native acceptance or held-out theorem evidence.

loading_only_repair_statistics.scope: All root/search/tree/children keys and ordinary field values preserved in insertion order. Per-load key table reuses equal string key objects across ordinary-value decodes and hierarchy mappings; values are unchanged. Ordinary values parsed once by standard JSONDecoder; duplicate keys retain Python last-wins semantics. Complete frozen actual bytes separately checked with unchanged v2 gate. Maximum ordinary field buffer32Mi characters, unresolved if exceeded; no strict universal JSON parser claim.
